## Baggage Policy

The carry-on and checked baggage allowance rules for Vistara will vary depending on the cabin class you're flying in. Read below to find out what size and weight restrictions you need to follow.

### Carry-on Baggage

All carry-on baggage cannot exceed 55cm x 40cm x 20cm (22" x 16" x 8") in the three dimensions.

Economy Class passengers carry-on baggage allowance is 7kg. [...] Premium Economy Class passengers carry-on baggage allowance is 10kg.

Business Class passengers carry-on baggage allowance is 12kg.

### Checked Baggage

Checked baggage allowance depends on the ticket purchased and the class passengers are travelling in. Please check your ticket for more information. No individual luggage should exceed 32kg for safety reasons.

## Cabin Classes [...] Vistara was the first airline to introduce premium economy seats on domestic routes in India and has a total of three different cabin classes to choose from. The airline is a full-service airline, with service such as baggage allowance and meals/snacks included in the price of the ticket. Vistara was established as a joint venture between Tata Sons (owns 51%) and Singapore Airlines (owns 49%).
